english.title: Service provider when providing informationsociety services did an act in EEA which would constitute an offence in UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were a service provider established in the United Kingdom who, in the course of a business and providing information society services, in an EEA State other than the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..),

(A)_[published a tobacco advertisement]_
(B)_[caused a tobacco advertisement to be published]_
(C)_[printed, a tobacco advertisement which was published in the United Kingdom]_
(D)_[devised, a tobacco advertisement which was published in the United Kingdom]_
(E)_[distributed a tobacco advertisement which was published in the United Kingdom]_
(F)_[caused a tobacco advertisement to be printed which was published in the United Kingdom]_
(G)_[caused a tobacco advertisement to be devised which was published in the United Kingdom]_
(H)_[caused a tobacco advertisement which was published in the United Kingdom to be distributed]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(4) and 16(2) of the Tobacco Advertising and Promotion Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date andlocation
service provider established in the United Kingdom
who in the course of providing information society services
did something in anEEA State other than the United Kingdom
which if done in the UK would constitute an offence under
section 2(1) or (2) of the TobaccoAdvertising and Promotion Act 2002

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
